subject: Error in x[, "energy__"] : subscript out of bounds

messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: Error in x[, "energy__"] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
I'm getting a strange error after upgrading to .14, from .12 - 
Error in x[, "energy__"] : subscript out of bounds

I am running a diffeq model with algorithm='Fixed_param', but running a simpler model doesn't create the error message. I can upload the stan code, but it's a real mess. I tried a bit to find a minimum-complexity reproduction of the error, but couldn't find it.

This seems strange to me because the variable x is in neither my stan code, nor the compiled C code. I assume that means it's in the BH / Stan Math libraries, but I don't know what to do about it. (Does this mean the output is problematic? Or can I safely ignore it?)

Any ideas?
